scenes.say: Ever wonder how cloud providers keep your apps running, even when hardware fails? Let's break down your options for high availability.

scenes.label: Set
scenes.sub: Spreads VMs across racks in one datacenter
scenes.say: First, an availability set spreads your virtual machines across multiple racks inside a single datacenter. This protects against rack failure and maintenance downtime.
Availability zones take it further. They place your resources in separate datacenters within a region, offering even higher uptime guarantees.
For disaster recovery, region pairs are key. You back up data in a second region, so your app survives even a regional outage.

scenes.question: Are sets and zones the same?
scenes.right: No, sets are inside one datacenter; zones are across multiple datacenters.
scenes.say: Don't mix up sets and zones. Sets only protect inside one datacenter, while zones span multiple datacenters for better resilience.
